change: The synthetic match to its end, in the engine's tests only: (1) a computer player on the engine's generic character AI with the engine tests' NoSpecialMoves hook; (2) the knock-out, the result screen and the epilogue back to the character screen; (3) the replay written at the end and read back by the engine's playback loader; (4) text drawn through an invented 3x5 glyph source. No engine source or package change.
implementation: one owner agent; the loop adopted the review's changes. Deviation: the card asked for each rung its own commit; all four are one commit, as they share one cached match run per process

rungs.computerPlayer: the computer is seat 1, plays in slot 11 as SyThree; it idles 73 bodies (P1 still blinking, not targeted), then walks up and runs to close in, first attack at body 118; over 150 bodies it pressed up 44, down 0, left 18, right 10, attack 19, jump 1, defend 0; launch and first-body cycles (220, 221), the frame chain, SHA-256 of bodies 1, 75 and 150, the World+Actors digest, the fighters every 25 bodies and the per-body buttons pinned
rungs.matchEnd: the knock-out at body 299 (P1 at -49 HP; the round timer starts at 300), the result recorded and drawn at body 400 (timer 101), the wait at body 443 (timer 144) until P1's scripted attack at cycle 680, the epilogue at cycle 683 back to the character screen; the whole-match chain, the result frames, the two frames after the epilogue, the knock-out and wait states and the end state (winner team 21, 398 ticks) pinned
rungs.replay: written to overlay/recording/20260101_000000_VS.lfr in the temporary pack: 10,073 bytes (a 4-byte length equal to the payload, then the compressed recording), equal on disk to the saved bytes, SHA-256 pinned; the engine's playback loader reads it back to the 0x630e18-byte recording (mode VS, catalog checksum, version 0xe7f, two results, team and ID per slot, ticks, player names pinned); the name is host-independent because the test's host answers a date whose local time is 2026-01-01 00:00:00 in any zone (the runtime converts in the current zone, OriginalMacRuntimeLoading.swift:414-418)
rungs.text: an invented 3x5 font at 2x draws the menu labels, every gameplay body's input-diagnostic line, the recording notices and the result screen's numbers and time; the HUD draws no names, only the team mark (frame 254 of the team font, OriginalWorldHUD.swift:116), and the result's player labels are bitmap-font draws (OriginalResultLayout.swift:113-125), so the glyph source does not reach them; otherwise the run is identical to the plain one (states, AI keys, replay bytes, 19,055 text calls)
